case_title: SANCHEZ MARIO VS AFFORDABLE AUTO REPAIR & SERVICE

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,000.00 FILED BY SANCHEZ MARIO AS TO DEFENDANT AFFORDABLE AUTO REPAIR & SERVICE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-22-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 08
